risks.risk: Monitor may be working but just not powered/connected (blank screen could be due to missing cable or no power).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the monitor powered on showing a desktop/any signal (with brightness/OSD visible).

risks.risk: Monitor model/size is unknown; value varies a lot by size and panel type.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the monitor label/sticker (model number and screen size) on the back.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic LG monitor scrap without knowing size/model (worst case).

risks.risk: Keyboard condition unknown (keys may be stuck, missing, or not responding).
risks.proof: A clip showing keyboard connected to a laptop/PC and typing works (or a photo of the keyboard label + test).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, video cable) could prevent testing and reduce usability.
risks.proof: Photos showing included cables/accessories: power cable and the exact video input cable(s) available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if cables/accessories are not guaranteed (worst case).

proof_requests: Video: power on the LG monitor and show it displaying an image (any input).
Close-up photo of the monitor back label (model number + screen size).
Photo/video of keyboard test (connected and keys responding).
response.reason: The photo confirms an LG monitor and a keyboard, but it does not prove the “scrap” (non-working) status or the exact monitor model/size—both are decisive for pricing. Request a power-on display clip and the back-label model photo.
